title: Atomic microcopy and error recovery patterns grooming
summary: Notes and proposals for atomic UI copy, inline error recovery patterns, and accessibility checks for console components (form fields, toasts, inline hints). Drafted during backlog grooming; actionable items and wireframe sketches included.
body:
Purpose
- Capture microcopy decisions at the component level so developers and docs have a single source of truth.
- Define recoverable error flows (what the product tries automatically, what the user sees, and suggested CTAs).
- Surface accessibility considerations for inline messages, live regions, and focus management.

Context and motivation
- Recent customer incident: bulk model-upload failure surfaced only as a toast; users had no way to retry specific items and screenreader users missed the toast entirely.
- Console team wants consistent small-surface messages: field-level, inline helpers, toasts, banners.
- Need to reduce support burden by encouraging recoverable patterns and better microcopy that guides next steps.

Scope (this doc)
- Atomic microcopy snippets for: text inputs, file upload, model version selector, topology selector, route creation form.
- Error recovery patterns: retry-by-item, inline suggestion, fallback route auto-switch.
- Accessibility notes: ARIA roles, live-region strategy, focus movement, visible focus outlines for dynamic elements.

Key principles (working list — finalize in style guide)
1) Intent-first: short phrase that explains what happened + consequence. Avoid technical error codes in primary copy.
2) Actionable CTA: provide a single clear next step (Retry, Switch to fallback, View details).
3) Fail-silent where appropriate: noncritical background tasks should use a subtle inline hint, not a banner.
4) Screenreader parity: every visible transient message must have an announcement strategy or persistent focusable affordance.
5) One-liner rule: primary microcopy <= 90 characters for most surfaces; secondary lines can expand.

Microcopy snippets (atomic library candidates)
- Field helper (normal): "Enter a name for this deployment (max 40 chars)."
- Field helper (optional): "Optional — add a description to help teammates understand this route."
- Inline validation (error): "Name can only include letters, numbers, and hyphens."
- Inline validation (success): "Name format looks good."
- File upload action (start): "Uploading model files — progress shown below."
- File upload error (recoverable): "Upload failed for 2/5 files. Retry failed files or continue without them."
- Toast (transient success): "Route created — now serving traffic."
- Toast (transient error): "Deployment failed. View details to retry or rollback."
- Persistent banner (critical): "Autoscaling temporarily disabled for this pool — requests may be queued."

Suggested ARIA/live-region handling
- Toaster: aria-live="polite" for non-blocking messages; use role="status". For critical failures that require immediate attention, use aria-live="assertive" and focus-management to land on a modal or banner.
- Inline field errors: connect aria-describedby to the error message element ID. Do not rely on color alone.
- File upload list: each file row should update a visually hidden live region with brief updates ("file X uploaded"), but aggregate complex failures into a summarized alert with keyboard focusable details.

Focus discipline rules (proposal)
- Non-modal toasts: do not move focus. Ensure there is a persistent link in the UI to review recent messages.
- Critical blocking errors (failed deployment): move focus to the banner with role=alert and make the primary CTA focusable.
- Inline suggestions that change available actions (e.g., switch to fallback variant): present a lightweight confirm dialog that traps focus.

Wireframe sketches (text descriptions)
1) Deployment form - inline file list
- Layout: form left, upload widget right.
- Each file row: filename | status pill (uploading/success/error) | action (retry/remove).
- Error state: row background subtle red 10%; error text inline and aria-describedby link.
- Recovery affordance: "Retry failed files" button above list.

2) Route creation - fallback auto-swap pattern
- After a detected inference runtime failure, UI: banner at top "Primary model unavailable — switching to compatible fallback." Primary CTA: "Undo" (3s undo window) and secondary CTA: "View details". Banner has role=alert and focus goes to first CTA.

Design-system tokens and variants required
- status.success.text, status.error.bg, toast.bg, banner.critical.bg, focus-outline-width, focus-outline-color.
- We need a dedicated token for "transient-announcement-bg" (high contrast for brief assertive messages).

Open questions and tradeoffs
- Politeness vs assertiveness: when to use assertive live regions (risk of interrupting screenreader flow) — propose assertive only for blocking errors that require user action.
- Undo affordances: should an automatic fallback be visible in audit logs only, or also surfaced to end users? Suggest both: UX banner + audit log entry.
- Toast discovery: some power users rely on console header message center. Do we duplicate messages? Risk of overload.

Backlog grooming outcomes (tasks and estimates)
- TASK A: Create atomic microcopy file (JSON) with variants for 30+ common messages; owner: Priya. Estimate: 2d.
- TASK B: Implement aria-live pattern in toast component and add tests (e2e + axe). Owner: Evan. Estimate: 3d.
- TASK C: File upload row recovery component (retry/remove) + keyboard interactions. Owner: Samir. Estimate: 5d.
- TASK D: Add design tokens for transient announcements and focus outline sizes. Owner: Design system. Estimate: 2d.
- TASK E: Create example flows in storybook showing normal, error, and recovered states for model upload and deployment. Owner: Marta. Estimate: 3d.
- Acceptance criteria (example for TASK C): keyboard focusable retry for each failed file; screenreader announces "N files failed" when upload completes; color contrast meets AA; unit + e2e tests pass.

Edge cases we should explicitly test
- Screenreader running + toast + modal appear simultaneously.
- Multiple inline errors added programmatically when form validated on submit.
- Rapid retry spam: keep debouncing and show progress state.
- Partial success for batch uploads: ensure user can act on subset.

Draft copy examples to be reviewed by content design
- Retry CTA label options: "Retry failed files" / "Retry selected" / "Retry all" — recommend "Retry failed files" as default.
- Fallback banner text options: "Switched to fallback model to keep requests live." vs "Primary model is unavailable — routing to fallback to avoid failures." — prefer the latter for clarity.

Notes to engineers
- Please avoid embedding strings in JSX; pull from new atomic microcopy JSON. Use keys like microcopy.upload.uploading and microcopy.toast.deployment_failed.
- Add unit tests that assert presence of aria attributes and focus movement for blocking cases.
- For toasts, implement a message center toggle that lists last 20 messages; this helps users who miss transient toasts.

Next steps / meeting actions
- Priya: draft atomic microcopy JSON and share in #console-ds by Wed 2026-02-11.
- Evan: prototype toast live region changes in storybook and link PR. Target demo at grooming on 2026-02-16.
- Samir: spike file-row keyboard interactions, bring prototype to UX touch-base.
- Marta: allocate design tokens and prepare color/contrast spec.

Appendix: quick checklist for PR reviewers
- Microcopy: is it <=90 chars and action-oriented?
- Accessibility: aria-live/role used appropriately, errors connected with aria-describedby, keyboard operable controls.
- Visual: contrast >= 4.5:1 for primary message text, focus ring visible at 3px minimum.
- Tests: include axe checks and a small a11y manual test doc attached to PR.

Unresolved questions (to triage in next meeting)
- Should toasts have a persistent 'copy' button for sharing error details with support?
- How granular should auditing be for auto-fallback events in customer logs?
- Final decision on assertive live region thresholds.

Rough timeline
- Feb 15: finalize microcopy JSON.
- Feb 22: toast/live-region changes merged.
- Mar 1: file upload recovery component merged + storybook examples.

End notes
- This is a working doc. Will extract to the design system repo once microcopy JSON is approved.
- Please add any missed examples in comments below — quick bullets are fine.
